clean_source: fresh extraction of a temporary standalone-repository ZIP; inputs and results were deleted before execution
comparison_rule: File sets and JSON/CSV structures were compared directly. JSON resource fields cpu_seconds, wall_seconds, peak_rss_kib, cpu_seconds_completed_chunks, and peak_rss_kib_completed_chunks, plus the matching cohorts.csv CPU/RSS columns, were excluded. No hash manifest was created.
execution: Three pilots, the 16 assurance groups, and all 100 deterministic campaign chunks were executed sequentially with one worker. Two outer tool calls reached the environment wall limit while guarded-11 and symbolic-21 were active. Neither active chunk had published its atomic result; each missing fixed index was then executed once to completion. Aggregation and final audit succeeded.
notes: Each chunk writes through a temporary file and publishes only after successful completion; no partial result was accepted.
The retained final evidence is the output of this clean run.
The 12 node-cap configurations remain unknown-node-cap; resource exhaustion was not relabeled as infeasibility.
Comparison covered pilots, assurance, final audit, two-tail witnesses, all generated inputs, certificates, replays, chunks, and aggregate tables.
